string.text: Persistent resources. Three offers after each wave. New runs start at wave 1.
Wave cleared. The game is paused. Choose a trade-off, skip, or retire with your banked reward.
Choose your replacement. Your old weapon and its ammunition will be traded in.
Two magazines in total, up to %d rounds. Springs inherit previous wear. No extra loose ammunition.

Choose a category and a weapon for the current tier. Cost: trade in the old weapon and ammunition for limited rounds, with two detachable magazines or a loaded weapon plus loose reserve. Spring wear persists.
Fill compatible magazines, including the installed one. Springs are not repaired. Cost: 3 extra enemies next wave.
Repair compatible magazine springs to 100%. Cost: health is capped at 50%; existing injuries are not healed.
Restore full body health and stop bleeding. Cost: 25% less reward next wave. Keep all magazines, ammunition and springs unchanged.
Receive one medkit and two bandages. Cost: 2 extra enemies next wave.
Receive armour from the next equipment tier. Cost: surrender half your loose compatible ammunition, retaining the rounded-up half. Loaded rounds stay unchanged.
Earn 50% more for the next wave. Cost: 2 extra enemies. Applies to one wave only.
60 seconds and compatible maintenance supplies. Cost: 25% less reward for the next wave.
%d seconds remaining. No enemies will spawn. Open inventory to perform maintenance, or finish early.
Continue with your current equipment, without an offer benefit or penalty.
End this run, collect the banked reward and recover your personal equipment.
Choose a weapon category. Equipment tier: %d. Then choose one of three weapons. The initial choice is required; you may retire.
Preparing your starting weapon selection. Combat begins after you confirm.
Add 1-3 compatible magazines with the condition and ammunition shown below. Cost: 2 extra enemies next wave.

Choose a category and tier-appropriate weapon at 30-90% condition, with 50% more ammunition. Cost: trade in the old weapon and supply. Two detachable magazines, or a loaded weapon plus loose reserve; spring wear persists.
Receive 1-3 compatible magazines at 30-80% remaining condition, each 25-75% full. With Bwais, springs have that same condition. Cost: 2 extra enemies next wave.
Receive loose compatible rounds: 25-75% of the category allowance. Cost: 25% less reward next wave. Existing magazines and springs stay unchanged.
Repair your weapon to 100%. Cost: lose half the loaded ammunition in each compatible magazine and weapon. Springs are not repaired.
Repair your current armour to 100%. Cost: 3 extra enemies next wave.
Up to %d rounds, split between the loaded weapon and loose reserve. Cost: trade in the old weapon and its supply. No detachable magazines are required.
Fill your weapon and receive a limited loose ammunition reserve for its category. Cost: 3 extra enemies next wave. No detachable magazines are required.
Half the normal enemies next wave, rounded up, with at least one opponent. Cost: 40% less reward for that wave only.
Replace your helmet with one from the next equipment tier at 100% condition. Cost: half your loose compatible ammunition; retain the rounded-up half. Loaded rounds stay unchanged.

Repair one worn compatible spare to 100%, keeping its loaded rounds. Receive half the rounds from the sacrificed spare as loose ammo. Cost: sacrifice your most worn compatible spare. Requires two worn spares; installed magazine stays. Odd refunds round down.
Receive one medkit, two bandages and half the rounds from the exchanged magazine as loose ammo. Cost: trade in your most worn compatible spare. Installed magazine is kept; odd refunds round down.
Receive loose compatible rounds: 25% of the category allowance. Cost: two bandages. Existing magazines and springs stay unchanged.
Receive one medkit and two bandages. Cost: half your loose compatible ammunition; retain the rounded-up half. Loaded rounds stay unchanged.
Restore full body health and stop bleeding. Cost: compatible spare springs lose 30% of their current condition, with a 10% floor. Keep all magazines and rounds; installed spring is unchanged.

Recover 50% of maximum body and limb health, capped at full, and stop bleeding. Cost: unload the least-filled compatible spare. All its rounds return to inventory; keep the magazine and spring. Installed magazine is unchanged.
Recover 50% of maximum body and limb health, capped at full, and stop bleeding. Cost: 2 extra enemies next wave. Keep all equipment and ammunition.
Choose a starting tier, then a category and weapon. Selected tier: %d.
Starting tier %d. Cost: %d magazines total; weapon %d%%; springs %d%%; ammunition %d%% of normal. Direct-loaded weapons receive loose reserve instead of magazines.
Starting tier %d. Cost: %d magazines total if supported; weapon %d%%; ammunition %d%% of normal. Direct-loaded weapons receive loose reserve.
Up to %d rounds across %d magazines in total, including the installed one.
Up to %d rounds split between weapon and loose reserve. No detachable magazines.
Receive %d compatible loose rounds. This replaces your perk choice.
Receive one empty compatible magazine. This replaces your perk choice.
Cost: %d loose compatible rounds. Keep at least one reserve round.
Cost: magazine and spring at %d%% condition.
No compatible detachable magazines are available for this weapon.
Additional initial reserve: %d loose rounds. Granted once.
